note: Offboarding / project handover assistant. Given to the agent: all project-related word / ppt / excel / email / meeting transcript / chat documents of an employee from the past six months, as well as the current project task list. The user: “I am leaving the team next month. Help me organize everything that needs to be handed over, tell me which things cannot be handed over directly to others, and help me prepare the handover document.” The agent needs to: ① find from different sources the projects the user has actually been responsible for and the implicit responsibilities; ② distinguish “already completed / in progress / verbally promised but no ticket / dependent on the user's personal knowledge”; ③ find potential successors for each piece of work; ④ check the successors' schedules and current workloads; ⑤ generate the handover document and modify/supplement the original project documents; ⑥ proactively ask about the parts where no owner can be found or information conflicts. Difficulty: the user's “responsibilities” do not exist completely in a single file; much information needs to be inferred from historical meetings and chats; tests cross-source entity resolution + implicit responsibility + conflict resolution + action execution.
env_description: offboarding_workspace/: project documents (2 docx summaries + an on-call duty schedule csv), emails/ (3 emails, including external contact dependencies), meeting_transcripts/ (3 meetings, with 3 implicit responsibilities planted: SMS gateway degradation strategy, Qingyun alert specification, mentoring an intern), chats/ (3 people, with verbal promises and unarchived personal knowledge planted), current_tasks.csv (8 tasks), team_calendar/ (ics for 5 people, with feasibility constraints planted: 张磊 is in closed development, 小林 has no calendar file and needs to be asked)
